title: RLHF & Gender-Bias Circuits in LLMs
award: 1st Place · Claude Builders Club × ML@UVA × UVA Data Science hackathon
description: Mechanistic-interpretability study of Gemma-3-4B base vs. instruct using WinoBias contrast pairs, per-head ablations, and logit-lens analysis — showing RLHF suppresses rather than removes gender bias via a late-layer counter-circuit.

title: Fluency
description: Camera-first language-learning app that identifies real-world objects, teaches their translation and pronunciation in six languages, and grades written and spoken quiz responses with LLM feedback.

title: Resonance
award: Winner, Best Use of Gemini API
description: Full-stack app that generates personalized music from YouTube playlists and natural-language prompts; prototyped playlist steering from MusicGen hidden-state activations as editable taste vectors, shipped generation on Lyria.

title: Satellite-Based Carbon Sequestration Estimation
description: Custom convolutional neural network built with Keras to classify multi-spectral Landsat 8 satellite imagery, reaching 89% validation accuracy segmenting Virginia's wetlands for climate-focused ML research.
